title: The etale topos of a scheme does not depend on the choice of universe for the small etale site
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter etale-cohomology.tex, section on comparing topologies
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the etale topos of a scheme S is determined up to canonical equivalence by S alone, independently of the construction of the small etale site inside a chosen partial universe (statement lines 2129-2131). The proof has to separate two different kinds of input: a set-theoretic one, that every affine scheme etale over S is isomorphic to an object of both big sites so that the two small categories are equivalent, and a topological one, that this equivalence and a quasi-inverse preserve standard etale coverings (proof lines 2140-2149). Only after both are in place does the criterion for comparing topologies apply. The claim is H2: a short but genuinely two-ingredient comparison.
